description:
**Dimension: doc-completeness · 17 findings (11 medium, 6 low)** — see report §doc-completeness. Scope narrowed 2026-08-07: 1 finding reassigned, 7 deferred, 9 retained here (see "Reassigned and deferred scope").

Fill required doc sections (description, `# Arguments`, `# Examples`, `# Panics`, `# Complexity`) on public items whose contracts are not evident from the signature.

Medium:
- `gf2-kernels-simd/src/lib.rs:83` — `LogicalFns` 15 public fn-pointer fields need per-field `///`.
- `gf2-core/src/matrix.rs:987` — `find_pivot_row` needs `# Examples` + `# Complexity`; `to_sparse` needs `# Complexity`.
- `gf2-core/src/sparse.rs:890` — `SpBitMatrix::from_dense`/`to_dense` need `# Examples`/`# Complexity`/`# Panics`.
- `gf2-coding/src/grand/orbgrand.rs:852,863` — `ln_1_plus_exp`/`log_sum_exp` need `# Arguments`/`# Examples`/`# Complexity`.
- `gf2-coding/src/ldpc/encoding/richardson_urbanke.rs:374` — `generator()` needs `# Panics` + `# Examples`.
- `gf2-coding/src/modem/analysis.rs:829` — `per_bit_mi_histogram_bits` needs `# Arguments`.
- `gf2-algebra/src/packed/packed5.rs:1410` — `Packed5Matrix` PartialEq/Debug impls need full doc blocks.

Low:
- `gf2-core/src/bitvec.rs:847,873` — `find_first_set`/`find_last_set` need `# Complexity`.
- `gf2-coding/src/ldpc/encoding/richardson_urbanke.rs:113`; `traits.rs:279,316`; `nr_5g/mod.rs:1306` — 4 ` ```ignore ` examples → `no_run` or self-contained.

## Reassigned and deferred scope

- **Reassigned to `ad978596`:** the `gf2-kernels-simd/src/lib.rs:1` crate-wide `#![allow(clippy::missing_safety_doc)]` removal and the real `# Safety` sections. That issue is now the sole owner.
- **Deferred to the documentation-overhaul epic:** the seven findings that request `# Examples` on accessor-, getter-, builder-, and simple-constructor-shaped items (`gf2-kernels-hip` ~20 public getters, `gf2-sim/src/presets/dvb_t2.rs:411` 6 builder methods, `gf2-sim/src/stages/mod.rs:274` 4 stage constructors, `gf2-sim/src/connector.rs` `Connector::new`, `gf2-sim/src/executor/results.rs:59` `SnrPointResult::from_counters`, `gf2-sim/src/parallel/mod.rs:259` `WorkerCounters::fer()`/`mean_iters()`, `gf2-coding/src/ldpc/nr_5g/mod.rs:1362,1385` `with_scale`/`with_algorithm`). Those are exactly the categories the workspace Rustdoc example audit classifies as tautological, and the policy that governs them is established by `3f29e945`. Adding them here would manufacture examples that the pruning pass then deletes.

The items retained above are non-trivial methods — a pivot search, dense/sparse conversions, numerically delicate log-domain helpers, a fallible generator construction — whose examples clarify contracts rather than restate signatures.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every item listed in the Medium and Low sections above gains the missing required sections; doctests compile and pass under `cargo test --doc` (use `no_run` only for device/GPU-dependent examples).
- [hard] REQ-02: All ` ```ignore ` examples in the four cited files converted to compilable `no_run` or self-contained form.
- [hard] REQ-03: No `# Examples` block is added to an accessor, constant, simple constructor, predicate, or direct field mapping; such items are out of scope here per "Reassigned and deferred scope".
- [hard] REQ-04: clippy `-D warnings` and fmt pass.
title: Fill public-API doc-completeness gaps
